skill.displayName: 知乎草稿写手 Zhihu Draft Writer
skill.summary: 自动从知乎热榜选题、调用 AI 生成原创回答并保存为草稿，支持自定义话题关键词、写作风格和批量生成。 Draft Zhihu answers automatically: picks hot questions, generates original answers via AI, and saves them...

latestVersion.changelog: 初始版本。支持知乎热榜自动选题、AI 生成原创回答、保存草稿、去重历史记录、自定义话题和写作风格。Initial release. Supports auto topic selection from Zhihu hot list, AI-generated original answers, draft saving, deduplication history, custom topics and writing styles.
